The season began on 20 July 2012 and is scheduled to end in May 2013. Ten teams will complete throughout the entire season. ==Teams== [[Colón C-3 F.C.|Colón C-3]] finished in 10th place in the overall table last season and were relegated to the [[Liga Nacional de Ascenso]].
